info.title: Pilots Bros: After the Striped Elephant
info.author: kasru
info.description: Reconstruction of the 1997 point-and-click adventure "Братья Пилоты: По следам полосатого слона" for Switch. Engine only - you need your own copy of the game.
info.details:
A native reconstruction of the 1997 Russian point-and-click adventure "Братья Пилоты: По следам полосатого слона", known in English as Pilots Bros: After the Striped Elephant. The original executable was disassembled and rewritten: the game still runs from its original bytecode scripts, while the C code around them is a clean-room interpreter written for this project.

ABOUT THE GAME (quoted from README.TXT on the original disc)
"This is the first game in the future game series with common main characters named Pilots Brothers. They are very popular in former Soviet Union due to famous animated cartoons. The game genre is a parody of a detective story, with elements of adventures, action, thrillers, humor, puzzles etc."

Game developer: GAMOS.
Copyright (C) 1997 GAMOS.
Copyright (C) 1997 1C (bound to the territory of ex-USSR).
Characters copyright (C) Second Frog and Moscow Animation Studio PILOT.

Nothing from the original game ships with this port - no data, no videos, no graphics - and this project is not affiliated with the game's rights holders.

WHAT YOU NEED
Your own copy of the game, as it came on the original PC CD:
  PILOTS.EXE   - the game data file (the original executable with the data appended to it)
  MOVIES/      - the video folder, including the .BMP files the engine looks for

WHERE TO PUT IT
Both go into the same folder as the port itself, on the SD card:
  sd:/switch/pilots/PILOTS_RE.nro    <- installed by this app
  sd:/switch/pilots/PILOTS.EXE       <- your copy of the game
  sd:/switch/pilots/MOVIES/          <- your copy of the videos
Then start PILOTS_RE.nro from the Homebrew Menu. The engine looks for its data in exactly that folder; if PILOTS.EXE is missing it stops with "Invalid game data file." and exits.

CONTROLS (gamepad)
  Left stick / D-pad .... move the pointer
  A ..................... left mouse button: use, confirm, open
  B ..................... right mouse button: cancel, back
  R (hold) .............. highlight every interactive object (what Ctrl does on PC)
  - (View / Share) ....... stretch the picture to the whole screen and back to 4:3
  X, Y, L ................ not assigned

WHAT THE PORT ADDS
A stretch toggle on the - button, a highlight of clickable objects while R is held, a visible loading indicator instead of a screen that looks frozen, and gamepad support through SDL. On Windows, macOS and Linux the same port is available with fullscreen, a log you can switch on with -log, and a browser installer that assembles the package for you:
  https://kasru.github.io/pilots-installer/

LINKS
Source code: https://github.com/kasru/pilots_re
All builds: https://github.com/kasru/pilots_re/releases

The game and its data belong to their rights holders; this port ships no game files.

changelog:
v1.0

First public release.

- Reconstruction of the original engine: the game logic still runs from the original bytecode scripts, the interpreter around them is written from scratch for this project.
- Nintendo Switch build with gamepad controls, a stretch toggle on the View/Share button, a highlight of clickable objects and a loading indicator.
- Separate builds for Windows x86/x64, Linux x86_64 and macOS 10.13-10.14, plus a browser installer that adds your copy of the game to the package.
